ordered_cutover: Commit only the request and owned evidence; preserve the four R5/R6 dirty paths unstaged.
Push the complete linear range and require Quality, Python 3.14 standard-GIL, and Security workflows to pass before runtime mutation.
Refresh Semantic, Reranker, Dashboard, and LAN Dashboard one at a time; verify one parent/child, direct_url commit, health, authority, and runtime drift after each.
Seal Ingest, config, candidate ledger/checkpoint, Workset main/WAL/SHM, process, lock, lease, and service pre-state.
Gracefully stop only com.trafficsign.chronovisor-ingest-drain.managed; verify parent/child exit and ingest/resource lock holders zero.
Start only com.trafficsign.omlx-muse; require one listener on 127.0.0.1:8002 and the exact configured local route/model identity.

Using the pushed exact Git-installed runtime, perform additive Workset migration, root authority bootstrap, and R0 candidate anchor; require legacy row/work/provenance/state digests unchanged and leased zero.

Run the real local-triad production receipt window with max_inflight 1 and claim_limit 7 under a 25-minute watchdog; require 21 quality receipts split 7/7/7, valid rate at least 95 percent, route skew at most 10 percent, 3 probes, all six failure categories, scheduler and resource receipts, no remote/OX egress, and leased zero.

On every exit restore ox-alpha-single-v1, max_inflight 10, claim_limit 1, ox_enabled false, and free_only true; stop Muse back to no listener; remove owned temp roots and verify no distillation process or lock holder.

Restore managed Ingest from the pushed runtime and verify one parent/child, new child as the only ingest/resource lock holder, direct_url commit, fresh liveness, Dashboard authority/mutation readiness, and no duplicate processes.

Only after the local gate and Ingest restoration, run a separately bounded free-only OX cap1 cohort with claim_limit 1, hard provider-call ceiling 20, zero cost, exact route/model identity, existing backoff/hard-stop, and ox_enabled false plus leased zero on exit.
Run the read-only R4 production collector and check R4 only if local, OX, production projection, source, lock, lease, resource, queue, and cost gates all pass.

downtime_budget.abort_rule: If fewer than 420 seconds remain or any gate fails, abort the formal run, restore config and Ingest immediately, and leave R4 unchecked.

rollback.pre_provider_failure: Do not enable OX; restore config, stop Muse, clean owned roots, and restore Ingest.
rollback.migration_failure: While all distillation locks and leases are zero, restore the sealed pre-migration Workset clone only if additive integrity or semantic identity changed; otherwise retain the noncertifying additive schema and restore services.
rollback.managed_service_failure: Stop the failed new service, restore its sealed pre-cutover plist/archive command for commit 37132ea, verify health, and do not advance to the next service.
rollback.local_formal_failure: Discard noncertifying partial local receipts from the owned attempt, restore config and Muse state, restart Ingest, and keep R4 unchecked.
rollback.ox_failure: Hard-stop remote egress, set ox_enabled false, release or reclaim every lease to zero, preserve failure receipts, and keep R4 unchecked.
rollback.sleep_converge: Never bootstrap, kickstart, bootout, or normalize Sleep/Converge during this cutover.

pre_acceptance: The pushed commit is the tested exact source and the required CI workflows are green.
Only the four named R5/R6 files are dirty and they are unstaged and absent from the push.
ox_enabled is false, free_only is true, claim_limit is 1, Workset leased is zero, and no distillation process or lock holder exists.
Ingest is a single managed parent/child and is the sole ingest/resource lock holder.
Sleep and Converge remain submitted, not running, spawn failed, with no matching process.
post_acceptance: Every refreshed managed archive direct_url equals the pushed commit and has one parent/child with no duplicates.
Production Workset migration is additive, integrity is ok, legacy digests are unchanged, active lease fields are zero, and a fresh v2 generation is used for certification.
The R0 anchor is sealed against the current candidate ledger/checkpoint and exact source modules; drift fails closed.
Local formal has 21 quality receipts, 7/7/7 routes, 3 probes, six failure categories, valid rate at least 95 percent, scheduler/resource evidence, and leased zero.
OX cap1 has at least 20 attempted receipts, valid rate at least 95 percent, exact free route/model identity, zero cost, provider calls no more than 20, no duplicates, and leased zero.
Final config is ox-alpha-single-v1, max_inflight 10, claim_limit 1, ox_enabled false, and free_only true.
Muse has no listener unless separately approved to remain running; Sleep and Converge preserve their pre-state.
Ingest is restored within 40 minutes with one new child holding the ingest/resource locks, fresh liveness, Dashboard authority/mutation ready, runtime drift false, and no active failure.
R4 remains unchecked unless the final read-only collector passes every production gate.
